# Unit test for function sort_array
def test_sort_array():
    # Empty array returns empty list
    assert sort_array([]) == []

    # Single element array
    assert sort_array([5]) == [5]

    # First + last is odd -> sort ascending
    assert sort_array([2, 4, 3, 0, 1, 5]) == [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]  # 2 + 5 = 7 (odd)
    assert sort_array([1, 2]) == [1, 2]                          # 1 + 2 = 3 (odd)
    assert sort_array([2, 1]) == [1, 2]                          # 2 + 1 = 3 (odd)

    # First + last is even -> sort descending
    assert sort_array([2, 4, 3, 0, 1, 4]) == [4, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0]  # 2 + 4 = 6 (even)
    assert sort_array([3, 5]) == [5, 3]                          # 3 + 5 = 8 (even)
    assert sort_array([5, 3]) == [5, 3]                          # 5 + 3 = 8 (even)

    # All identical elements
    assert sort_array([1, 1, 1]) == [1, 1, 1]                    # 1 + 1 = 2 (even)

    # Negative numbers: odd sum -> ascending
    assert sort_array([-2, -4, 3, 0, 1, -5]) == [-5, -2, 0, 1, 3, 4]  # -2 + -5 = -7 (odd)

    # Negative numbers: even sum -> descending
    assert sort_array([-2, -4, 3, 0, 1, -4]) == [3, 1, 0, -2, -4, -4]  # -2 + -4 = -6 (even)

    print("All sort_array tests passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_sort_array()
